description: This Java source file defines the class 'WithTenantContextExtension', which is a JUnit 5 extension implementing BeforeEachCallback and AfterEachCallback to set up and tear down tenant context for tests annotated with @WithTenantContext.

classes.name: WithTenantContextExtension
classes.description: A JUnit 5 extension that manages tenant context before and after each test method that is annotated with @WithTenantContext.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets the tenant context based on @WithTenantContext annotation in the current test method.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Restores the original tenant context after the test method has run.

methods.name: hasAnnotation
methods.description: Checks if the test method has the @WithTenantContext annotation.
